my-expenses-revanced.description: My Expenses ReVanced builds upon the original My Expenses app by Michael Totschnig, an open-source personal finance tracker for managing accounts, expenses, income, budgets, and transactions with features like CSV/QIF export and reconciliation. This modification applies the 'Unlock pro' patch (available in official ReVanced patches and forks) to the package org.totschnig.myexpenses, bypassing premium barriers to enable pro features without payment.
